 Rs 12 Crore Prize Bumper Diwali Lottery Soon: Punjab State Lottery Vs Kerala Lottery; Dates, Tickets, Prizes
 News oi-Pooja Jaiswar By Pooja Jaiswar 
 Updated: Friday, November 13, 2026, 19:14 [IST]
 Add as a preferred source on Google Two bumper lotteries are scheduled for Diwali festival by two different states in India. But both states are offering an exciting bumper prize of Rs 12 crore each. These are called Punjab State Dear Diwali Bumper and Kerala Pooja Bumper BR-112 lottery. Both are scheduled to be released in November month.
 Punjab State Dear Diwali Bumper 2026: Check Result Date, Ticket Price, Prize Structures
 The Punjab Dear Diwali bumper lottery tickets are at Rs 500 per ticket. The result date is fixed on November 16, 2026, starting 6:00 PM onwards.
 Tickets are printed across 12 zodiac-named series, each carrying an identical, equal chance of winning. As per Punjab Lottery Org, here's what the tickets mean as per Zodiac signs:
 1. Aries - The Ram - Symbol of courage, energy and new beginnings.
 2. Taurus - The Bull - Represents patience, stability and material comfort.
 3. Gemini - The Twins - Signifies duality, curiosity and quick thinking.
 4. Cancer - The Crab - Associated with home, family and deep emotion.
 5. Leo - The Lion - Symbol of leadership, confidence and generosity.
 6. Virgo - The Maiden - Represents precision, service and practicality.
 7. Libra - The Scales - Signifies balance, harmony and fairness.
 8. Scorpio - The Scorpion - Associated with intensity, passion and transformation.
 9. Sagittarius - The Archer - Symbol of optimism, adventure and freedom.
 10. Capricorn - The Sea-Goat - Represents discipline, ambition and perseverance.
 11. Aquarius - The Water-Bearer - Signifies innovation, individuality and a humanitarian spirit.
 12. Pisces - The Fish - Associated with compassion, imagination and intuition.
 Every ticket for the Punjab State Dear Diwali Bumper 2026 belongs to one of twelve series, each named after a zodiac sign and numbered 700000 to 999999. The names are simply series labels - every series carries an identical, equal chance in the draw, as per Punjab Lottery website.

 Kerala Pooja Bumper BR-112 Lottery 2026: Check Result Date, Ticket Price, Prize Structures
 The ticket for Pooja bumper lottery is Rs 300 per ticket. The tickets are in five series namely JA, JB, JC, JD, JE. The sale for Pooja bumper lottery tickets began from September 28, 2026. The Hon'ble Health and Devaswom Minister K. Muraleedharan inaugurated the sale of the Pooja bumper lottery at Gorkhy Bhavan, Thiruvananthapuram.
 The result will be announced on November 28, 2026. The lucky draw will go live at 2:00 pm from Gorkhy Bhavan, Thiruvananthapuram. The full results should be released by 4:00 pm.
 The prize structure for Pooja bumper lottery varies from the first prize to the last. For 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th and 5th, winning tickets will be common to all series. However, from 6th prize to 9th prize, the last four digits will be drawn, and for consolation prize, all other series with first prize numbers.
 The agents of first, second and third prize winning tickets will be eligible to receive 10% of the total winning amount.
